name: race_offline_outcome_both_fell_draw
description: A race drawn because both Holdfasts fell on the same wave with as many of it killed says that rule (design 1.3: both fell, the later wave, then more of that wave's creeps killed, then a draw; review of M6's race views: every draw read 'Two crews, one time', the title again, though neither crew set a time). Over the session's offline race, a Tide Race of two seats: both hollows wait in the window after wave 5 and both lose every life in the same frame. Both fell on wave 6 with no creep of it killed, SimMatch.outcomes() says draw for both, and the results say 'Two Crews, One Time' with the rule 'Both fell on wave 6 with as many of its creeps killed'.

steps.assert: Game.sim.teams[0].fell_wave == 6 and Game.sim.teams[1].fell_wave == 6 and Game.sim.teams[0].fell_kills == Game.sim.teams[1].fell_kills
steps.msg: both Holdfasts fell on wave 6, with as many of it killed
neither crew set a race time
the simulation calls it a draw for both teams

steps.assert: node('ResultsTitle').text == 'TWO CREWS, ONE TIME' and node('ResultsRule').text == 'Both fell on wave 6 with as many of its creeps killed'
steps.msg: the results name the rule that tied, not the title again
